mechanism.short_read: Read the frame described by the checked descriptor. Header, encoded digest and paired-bank geometry remain checked independently.
mechanism.post_fence: Reuse the bounded frame buffer for stored-only verification of both mirrors.
mechanism.fixture: Inject and count a fault at the byte read from the modeled backing, including an offset internal to a coalesced read.

routing.initial_failure: The index daemon connection was lost while the job reached its measured allocation boundary. The bounded restored run searched the isolated mirror at current main.

profile.method: Timed only writable resume of in-memory volumes on the Windows host. Three pairs per workload, order AB, BA, AB. Both profile binaries used identical no-fault fixture code before the test-only fault injection patch.

public_input.source: CPython 3.15.2 Lib, 2,640 files from the recorded release catalog

profile.limits: Backing calls in the fixture measure software operations. Physical storage and whole-product performance remain open.

asan.reason: The first envelope hit its commitment cap during two fixtures. The unchanged instrumented binaries and runtime settings passed both groups under a larger live-headroom-derived envelope.

regression.resolution: Merged reads exposed start-offset-dependent fault injection. Covered-byte targeting restored the fault. The partial rebuild confirmed two groups but left two test executables stale. Final builds rebuilt all four.

mounted_correctness.workload: Signed WinFsp 2.2 populated external Win32 overwrite, rename, helper interruption, independent recovery and continued writes. Guest correctness scope.
